name: Steamos
tagline: An Arch based Linux distribution made by Valve Software. This container is a vanilla Arch install with Steam repositories added for software support. This container will only work with modern AMD/Intel GPUs on a real Linux Host
description: SteamOS is an Arch based Linux distribution made by Valve Software. This container is a vanilla Arch install with Steam repositories added for software support. This container will only work with modern AMD/Intel GPUs on a real Linux Host

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
services:
  app:
    image: linuxserver/steamos:version-2024-12-20@sha256:04adf2c7af1c97c7cf9d8949aebeeaa8ccfc672e24e6bbebe72a95b06013f5af
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      PUID: $PUID
      PGID: $PGID
      TZ: $TZ
      DRINODE: ''
      HOST_IP: ''
      STARTUP: ''
      RESOLUTION: ''
    ports:
      - target: 3000
        published: "${APP_PORT}"
        protocol: tcp
      - target: 3001
        published: 3001
        protocol: tcp
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/config
        target: /config
      - type: bind
        source: /dev/input
        target: /dev/input
      - type: bind
        source: /run/udev/data
        target: /run/udev/data
